local.headline: MLGW power back after holiday outages; fatal North Memphis shooting probed
body: Power has been restored after outages hit more than 1,900 MLGW customers around noon on Thanksgiving, Action News 5 reported. Most were reported around Cordova, near Germantown and Walnut Grove roads, and the cause was not clear. Separately, police are looking into a fatal Thanksgiving shooting in North Memphis, according to Action News 5. WREG reported that a man was killed.
FOX13 Memphis reported that Memphis Animal Services will hold a pet adoption event from noon to 4 p.m. Saturday and Sunday at 2350 Appling Cove. The city said 190 cats and dogs are ready for homes.

sources.title: Man killed in North Memphis shooting

state.headline: Snow falls on Thanksgiving; Tennessee band stays for delayed Macy's parade
body: Thanksgiving brought snow to parts of Tennessee. WSMV published photos from around Middle Tennessee, and WVLT also shared pictures of the holiday snowfall.

WSMV reported that the Dobyns-Bennett High School band from East Tennessee is extending its New York City stay to play in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, which bad weather pushed to Saturday. The trip involves nearly 400 students, and the band director said it had already cost about $750,000.

sources.title: Photos of Thanksgiving snow in Middle Tennessee
School band extends New York stay for parade

federal.headline: Thanksgiving storm disrupts travel and power; Trump disputes GDP figures
body: A Thanksgiving storm system brought rough weather to large parts of the country. New York's governor declared a state of emergency for southern areas of the state, including New York City and Long Island, ABC News reported. CBS News, citing FlightAware, said about 1,300 flights were delayed Thursday morning and another 400 or so canceled. A later NBC News headline reported hundreds of thousands of people without power.

PBS NewsHour reported that President Trump on Thursday accused the Commerce Department of deliberately issuing wrong growth numbers ahead of the midterms and said he wants it investigated. ABC News reported that the department's Wednesday revision put third-quarter growth at an annual rate of 4.3%, up from an earlier estimate of 3.4%.

sources.title: New York emergency declaration ahead of storm

international.headline: Two Italians killed in Kuwait drone strike; Iran denies responsibility
body: Two Italians were killed in a drone strike in Kuwait, and Iran denied responsibility, according to a UPI headline. A U.S. News headline attributed the drones to Iran. The same headline reported that Israeli strikes killed 10 people in Gaza; an earlier headline carried by ClickOrlando put that number at 8.

In Ukraine, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned Thursday that Russia is preparing another major attack on energy infrastructure and other critical services, PBS NewsHour reported. A Kyiv Independent headline said Russian attacks over the past day killed 6 people, injured 25 and caused power outages in six regions.
